mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_print_order (email, baby_no, order_id, status, total_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail) VALUES (#{email}, #{babyNo}, #{orderId}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail})
INSERT INTO tbl_print_order_item (order_no, album_no, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{albumNo}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT order_no, email, baby_no, order_id, payment_key, status, total_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_print_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT pi.item_no, pi.album_no, pi.quantity, pi.unit_price, ba.photo_file_name FROM tbl_print_order_item pi JOIN tbl_baby_album ba ON pi.album_no = ba.album_no WHERE pi.order_no = #{orderNo}

SELECT order_no, email, baby_no, order_id, payment_key, status, total_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, reg_time, mod_time FROM tbl_print_order WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY reg_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}
